primordial-club.name: Primordial Club
primordial-club.description: Whittled from ironwood in a single evening, and it has not snapped since.

clearing-vest-t1.name: Bark Wrap
clearing-vest-t1.description: Bound bark and twine, smelling of sap and rain — the first armor any wanderer learns to make.

clearing-charm-t1.name: Herb Pouch
clearing-charm-t1.description: A drawstring pouch of bruised green leaves, gathered at the forest edge.

clearing-boots-t1.name: Soft Boots
clearing-boots-t1.description: Worn soft by a hundred miles of easy trail.

chaotic-axe.name: Chaotic Axe
chaotic-axe.description: A wild, top-heavy thing that fights as much as it is wielded.

cave-vest-t1.name: Bestial Hide
cave-vest-t1.description: The hide of something large and unlucky, cured to a stubborn toughness.

cave-charm-t1.name: Pulse Stone
cave-charm-t1.description: A cave-crystal that beats, slow and steady, like a sleeping heart.

cave-boots-t1.name: Bat Wing Boots
cave-boots-t1.description: Stretched membrane that falls on stone without a whisper.

ruinous-axe.name: Ruinous Axe
ruinous-axe.description: Bigger, meaner, and somehow better balanced — chaos with the faintest thread of discipline.

cave-vest-t2.name: Dire Bestial Hide
cave-vest-t2.description: From a beast the deep-cavern folk name only in low voices.

cave-charm-t2.name: Resonant Gem
cave-charm-t2.description: A gem that rings on its own in the dark, answering a song no one else hears.

cave-boots-t2.name: Cavern Sprints
cave-boots-t2.description: Worn smooth on tunnel floors no map has ever charted.

cave-cataclysm-axe.name: Cataclysm Axe
cave-cataclysm-axe.description: Chaos given an edge — and, at last, a little rhythm. Every fifth swing still finds only air.

cave-vest-t3.name: Deepscale Hide
cave-vest-t3.description: Layered scale over thick hide — nothing fancy, just the most of everything that stops a blow.

cave-charm-t3.name: Echo Geode
cave-charm-t3.description: It pulses on its own clock, and hums a low, steady mending between the beats.

cave-boots-t3.name: Echostep Treads
cave-boots-t3.description: They give back no sound at all — not even the echo the deep stone expects.

core-tempered.name: Tempered Core
core-tempered.description: Balanced for any hand. It asks no commitment, and rewards none in particular.

core-duelist.name: Duelist Core
core-duelist.description: Each direct hit on the same target sharpens your focus. Change targets, and the edge must be honed again.

flash-rapier.name: Flash Rapier
flash-rapier.description: Forged thin as a reed by duelists who prized speed above all.

forest-vest-t1.name: Shaded Bindings
forest-vest-t1.description: Woven in the dappled dark beneath the canopy, where shadow clings to cloth.

forest-charm-t1.name: Heartroot Amulet
forest-charm-t1.description: Heartroot drawn from the oldest tree in the grove, still faintly warm.

forest-boots-t1.name: Sprinter Wraps
forest-boots-t1.description: Strips of supple hide that move when you move, and never before.

gale-needle.name: Gale Needle
gale-needle.description: A fencing blade machined to an impossible point, humming faintly when drawn.

thorn-needle.name: Thorn Needle
thorn-needle.description: The same blade, barbed — it bites and lets the wound do the rest.

forest-vest-t2.name: Phantom Bindings
forest-vest-t2.description: They say the weaver vanished the day it was finished. The cloth remembers the trick.

forest-charm-t2.name: Ancient Heartroot Amulet
forest-charm-t2.description: A relic of a grove that burned an age ago, its life somehow undimmed.

forest-boots-t2.name: Windstep Wraps
forest-boots-t2.description: Light enough that the wind mistakes the wearer for one of its own.

jungle-stinger-rapier.name: Stinger Rapier
jungle-stinger-rapier.description: A thin blade kept slick with something the jungle distilled and never named.

jungle-vest-t2.name: Verdant Weave
jungle-vest-t2.description: A living mesh of leaf and creeper, too quick and too giving to be struck square.

jungle-charm-t2.name: Canopy Heart
jungle-charm-t2.description: A knot of ancient vine that wakes, slowly, to the rhythm of a long fight.

jungle-boots-t2.name: Vine Wraps
jungle-boots-t2.description: Springy growth lashed to the feet, always eager to be running.

jungle-venomthorn-rapier.name: Venomthorn Rapier
jungle-venomthorn-rapier.description: Thin and quick, and slick with a thorn-sap that bites a little more with every touch.

jungle-vest-t3.name: Wildgrowth Weave
jungle-vest-t3.description: A living mesh of leaf and vine, too quick and too giving to ever quite be struck square.

jungle-charm-t3.name: Worldvine Heart
jungle-charm-t3.description: It wakes slowly to a long fight, and by the end is pouring life back faster than it leaves.

jungle-boots-t3.name: Canopy Striders
jungle-boots-t3.description: They crash through the green loud enough to turn every hungry thing your way.

jungle-deathfang-rapier.name: Deathfang Rapier
jungle-deathfang-rapier.description: Quick past seeing, and slick with something the deep jungle spent a long time perfecting.

jungle-vest-t4.name: Primal Canopy
jungle-vest-t4.description: The faster you move through the green, the less of you there is to strike.

jungle-charm-t4.name: Ancient Canopy
jungle-charm-t4.description: Older than the trees around it, and by a long fight's end it is pouring life back faster than any blade can take it.

jungle-charm-t4-overgrowth.name: Overgrowth Pulse
jungle-charm-t4-overgrowth.description: It grows past the wound and keeps growing, hardening the surplus into a living shell.

jungle-boots-t4.name: Warpath Treads
jungle-boots-t4.description: They tear through the green loud enough to wake the whole canopy — and bring all of it to you at once.

core-survivalist.name: Survivalist Core
core-survivalist.description: Wound-knit heartwood. It does not stop the blow — it shortens the time you spend regretting it.

core-bruiser.name: Bruiser Core
core-bruiser.description: Kill, and the jungle opens. Stop, and it closes. The core only knows how to do the first one.

core-accelerant.name: Accelerant Core
core-accelerant.description: The canopy keeps a fast rhythm. Match it, and you will find you are swinging before you decide to.

relic-verdant-flywheel.name: Verdant Flywheel
relic-verdant-flywheel.description: Its living spokes turn faster with every gift the mechanic gives back.

heavy-hammer.name: Heavy Hammer
heavy-hammer.description: Two-handed, brutal, and honest. It asks only that you find the time to swing it.

mountain-vest-t1.name: Fallen Knight Plate
mountain-vest-t1.description: Stripped from a knight who fell at the high pass and was never named.

mountain-charm-t1.name: Granite Barrier
mountain-charm-t1.description: A palm of carved granite, cold and patient as the peak it came from.

mountain-boots-t1.name: Iron Treads
mountain-boots-t1.description: Heavy soles that bite into scree and loose rock alike.

quake-hammer.name: Quake Hammer
quake-hammer.description: When it lands, the ground remembers it longer than the foe does.

mountain-vest-t2.name: Iron Crusader Plate
mountain-vest-t2.description: Masterwork plate of the old crusades, dented in a hundred places, breached in none.

mountain-charm-t2.name: Iron Bulwark
mountain-charm-t2.description: A ward-stone the mountainfolk pass down, hand to weathered hand.

mountain-boots-t2.name: Mountain Stride
mountain-boots-t2.description: Forged for those who treat a sheer slope as a road.

mountain-avalanche-maul.name: Avalanche Maul
mountain-avalanche-maul.description: It does not so much strike as arrive, the way a slope arrives on a village.

mountain-vest-t3.name: Summit Aegis
mountain-vest-t3.description: Forged for those who plan to be hit by something the size of a house and walk on.

mountain-charm-t3.name: Bastion Heart
mountain-charm-t3.description: A core of mountain-heart stone that raises a wall of itself, over and over.

mountain-boots-t3.name: Peak Stride
mountain-boots-t3.description: Not even the mountain can keep you from your prey.

mountain-earthsunder-maul.name: Earthsunder Maul
mountain-earthsunder-maul.description: It does not strike the earth so much as remind it of an old grievance.

mountain-warmaul.name: Warmaul
mountain-warmaul.description: Lighter in the haft, quicker to the shoulder — it rewards the soldier who already knows when to swing.

mountain-vest-t4.name: Titan's Keep
mountain-vest-t4.description: The blow that should have ended you instead rings the walls — and the walls answer by standing back up.

mountain-vest-t4-stormwall.name: Stormwall Plate
mountain-vest-t4-stormwall.description: Built to take the storm head-on and turn what it absorbs back into a second wind.

mountain-charm-t4.name: Fortress Heart
mountain-charm-t4.description: A keep in miniature: it throws up a wall, lets it fall, and throws up another, tireless as siegework.

mountain-charm-t4-shieldmend.name: Shieldmend Ward
mountain-charm-t4-shieldmend.description: When the ward shatters, it gives back a little of the blow it ate.

mountain-boots-t4.name: Vanguard Stride
mountain-boots-t4.description: While a foe stands at distance, they close the gap as if the mountain itself leaned them forward.

core-juggernaut.name: Juggernaut Core
core-juggernaut.description: The mountain does not dodge. It simply outlasts whatever is thrown at it, and so will you.

core-arcanist.name: Arcanist Core
core-arcanist.description: Thin air, long thoughts. The gap between what you can do and how often shrinks.

relic-colossus-heart.name: Colossus Heart
relic-colossus-heart.description: A mountain heartbeat: slow enough to feel inevitable, heavy enough to end the argument.

relic-equilibrium-shard.name: Equilibrium Shard
relic-equilibrium-shard.description: A clean answer with no hidden edge: a little more rhythm, a little more force.

iron-broadsword.name: Iron Broadsword
iron-broadsword.description: Mass-forged for the ranks, dependable as sunrise. Ten thousand like it have won quiet wars.

plains-vest-t1.name: Survivor's Robe
plains-vest-t1.description: Field plate patched and repatched by those who lived to patch it.

plains-charm-t1.name: Plains Stone
plains-charm-t1.description: A sun-warmed stone from the heart of the grasslands, humming with quiet vigor.

plains-boots-t1.name: Fleet Boots
plains-boots-t1.description: Open sandals built for crossing flat ground at a dead run.

knight-steelsword.name: Knight's Steelsword
knight-steelsword.description: A knight sidearm kept keen by habit and pride — plain, proven, never flashy.

plains-vest-t2.name: Enduring Robe
plains-vest-t2.description: Plate that has outlasted the wars it was made for, and the smith who made it.

plains-charm-t2.name: Stalwart Heart
plains-charm-t2.description: A greater plains-stone, its warmth swelling with every foe laid low.

plains-boots-t2.name: Gale Boots
plains-boots-t2.description: Wind-cured leather that seems to lean into every stride.

ashbrand-blade.name: Poison Dagger
ashbrand-blade.description: A short blade kept slick with mire-venom that refuses to dry.

swamp-vest-t1.name: Arcane Wrappings
swamp-vest-t1.description: Marsh-cloth steeped in old wardings against rot and fume.

swamp-charm-t1.name: Murk Eye
swamp-charm-t1.description: A preserved golem eye, still weeping faint green light.

swamp-boots-t1.name: Marsh Treads
swamp-boots-t1.description: Broad soles that ride the surface of soft, sucking ground.

swamp-mirebrand.name: Venom Knife
swamp-mirebrand.description: The venom runs deeper now; what it touches keeps rotting.

swamp-vest-t2.name: Bog Wrappings
swamp-vest-t2.description: Cloth drawn from the deepest mire, where even the water has forgotten the sun.

swamp-charm-t2.name: Bog Eye
swamp-charm-t2.description: A bog-touched eye that drinks deep and gives quietly back.

swamp-boots-t2.name: Wetland Wraps
swamp-boots-t2.description: Enchanted bindings that find footing where there should be none.

swamp-blightbrand.name: Plague Fang
swamp-blightbrand.description: The rot it carries does more work than the edge ever could.

swamp-vest-t3.name: Plaguebound Shroud
swamp-vest-t3.description: It turns the blows you take into a slow ache it then refuses to feel.

swamp-charm-t3.name: Sorrow Eye
swamp-charm-t3.description: It weeps for every wound, and gives the tears back as strength.

swamp-boots-t3.name: Mire Striders
swamp-boots-t3.description: Nothing the bog grips holds them; they walk free of any mire that tries to keep them.

tundra-permafrost-maul.name: Permafrost Maul
tundra-permafrost-maul.description: Each blow leaves a deep frost-crack; armor that takes enough of them simply gives.

tundra-rimebrand.name: Rimebrand
tundra-rimebrand.description: The first true frost-brand — slow and heavy, planting a cold in the wound that goes on biting after the blade is gone.

tundra-vest-t3.name: Glacial Bulwark
tundra-vest-t3.description: Stand still and the ice creeps over the plate, until you are part of the glacier itself.

tundra-charm-t3.name: Frostward Charm
tundra-charm-t3.description: A rime-cold ward that throws up a sheet of ice, and drinks the blows that get through.

tundra-boots-t3.name: Glacier Striders
tundra-boots-t3.description: They gather momentum across the ice and are loath to give it back.

tundra-glacial-tyrant-maul.name: Glacial Tyrant Maul
tundra-glacial-tyrant-maul.description: Every blow leaves a deeper frost-crack; the eighth simply ends the argument about whether armor holds.

tundra-glacial-rimebrand.name: Glacial Rimebrand
tundra-glacial-rimebrand.description: It does not cut so much as plant a cold that goes on spreading after the blade is gone.

tundra-vest-t4.name: Permafrost Sovereign
tundra-vest-t4.description: Hold your ground and the glacier claims you for its own — and nothing moves a glacier.

tundra-charm-t4.name: Glacial Ward
tundra-charm-t4.description: A sheet of ice thrown up against the blow, and a slow cold that drinks whatever slips past it.

tundra-charm-t4-deepfreeze.name: Deepfreeze Ward
tundra-charm-t4-deepfreeze.description: The longer the cold has to settle in, the more of the blow it swallows whole.

tundra-boots-t4.name: Avalanche Striders
tundra-boots-t4.description: Slow to start and impossible to stop — by the far end of the ice you are a thing that simply happens to whatever is in the way.

core-scout.name: Scout Core
core-scout.description: Open ground and a long horizon. Nothing here helps you win a stand — only avoid one.

relic-glacial-bell.name: Glacial Bell
relic-glacial-bell.description: It rings only when the moment is ready, and every boon carries the note.

desert-sunsteel-cross.name: Sunsteel Falchion
desert-sunsteel-cross.description: Sun-forged and ward-etched: the opening blow breaks, and for a few breaths after it the light does not let go.

desert-vest-t2.name: Duneplate of the Last Stand
desert-vest-t2.description: Plate of the standfast dead, who are said to have refused to fall even once.

desert-charm-t2.name: Mirage Talisman
desert-charm-t2.description: A shard of cooled glass that shows you water which is not there, and mends what is.

desert-boots-t2.name: Sand Sprint
desert-boots-t2.description: Wide and light, made to outpace a storm across open dune.

desert-solar-cross.name: Solar Falchion
desert-solar-cross.description: It spends its fury on the opening blow, then burns on a while in the wound it made.

desert-vest-t3.name: Eternal Duneplate
desert-vest-t3.description: Worn by the standfast dead, who shed curses like sand and refused, once, to die.

desert-charm-t3.name: Oasis Heart
desert-charm-t3.description: A patient spring that helps you find the strength to purge curses and break your bonds again sooner.

desert-boots-t3.name: Mirage Striders
desert-boots-t3.description: By the time the storm reaches where you stood, you are already a rumor on the next dune.

desert-zenith-cross.name: Zenith Falchion
desert-zenith-cross.description: At the sun's height the opening cut lets in the whole day, and it takes its time going out.

desert-vest-t4.name: Deathless Duneplate
desert-vest-t4.description: The standfast dead refused to fall — and the wounds closed as the refusal held.

desert-charm-t4.name: Last Oasis
desert-charm-t4.description: The last spring never runs dry; each purge and broken bond brings the next within reach.

desert-boots-t4.name: Simoom Striders
desert-boots-t4.description: Named for the desert wind that arrives only as the dust it already left behind.

core-force.name: Force Core
core-force.description: It gives you the strike you wanted and takes the margin you were counting on.

core-sniper.name: Sniper Core
core-sniper.description: Focuses the eye to a needlepoint, and leaves the body that much more exposed.

relic-withering-lens.name: Withering Lens
relic-withering-lens.description: It takes its time finding the flaw, then makes the flaw impossible to ignore.

volcanic-cinderlash.name: Cinderlash
volcanic-cinderlash.description: A whip of braided ember that strikes faster the longer it burns.

volcanic-vest-t3.name: Emberforge Plate
volcanic-vest-t3.description: Plate quenched in a lava flow; it thickens against a steady fire and cracks only to a true blow.

volcanic-charm-t3.name: Magmaheart Stone
volcanic-charm-t3.description: A still-molten heart that mends you mid-fight, and flares with every kill.

volcanic-boots-t3.name: Magma Walkers
volcanic-boots-t3.description: Quick as a thrown spark — until a solid blow knocks the wind from them.

volcanic-eruption-lash.name: Eruption Lash
volcanic-eruption-lash.description: A braided whip of ember that strikes faster the longer it is allowed to burn.

volcanic-blightbrand.name: Cinderbrand
volcanic-blightbrand.description: It leaves a fire under the skin that does the rest of the work while you move on.

volcanic-vest-t4.name: Pyroclasm Mantle
volcanic-vest-t4.description: It thickens against a steady fire until, at its hardest, it shrugs off even a true blow — once.

volcanic-vest-t4-lavatempered.name: Lava-Tempered Hide
volcanic-vest-t4-lavatempered.description: Quenched in a living flow, it banks the overflow of your own healing into a crust of fresh stone.

volcanic-charm-t4.name: Inferno Heart
volcanic-charm-t4.description: A heart that never fully cools — it mends you mid-swing and flares brighter with every fallen foe.

volcanic-boots-t4.name: Pyroclast Treads
volcanic-boots-t4.description: Swift as a thrown ember — until a solid blow stalls them, and the heat must build again.

core-catalyst.name: Catalyst Core
core-catalyst.description: Amplifies on-hit damage you already have; it grants none by itself. Armour is no comfort against something already inside it.

relic-hastebound-dial.name: Hastebound Dial
relic-hastebound-dial.description: The dial runs ahead of every rhythm, trading weight for relentless motion.

graveyard-plague-axe.name: Plague Axe
graveyard-plague-axe.description: Every third stroke lands flat and harmless — and leaves the rot to make the next one count double.

graveyard-vest-t4.name: Plaguebound Mantle
graveyard-vest-t4.description: The denser the swarm, the thicker the crust of clinging filth — and the harder you are to bite.

graveyard-vest-t4-debtward.name: Grave Ward
graveyard-vest-t4-debtward.description: It lets the debt of a hundred small wounds come due all at once — and then forgives it, once.

graveyard-charm-t4.name: Necrotic Pulse
graveyard-charm-t4.description: A slow, certain throb of returning life, timed like a tired heart that refuses to stop.

graveyard-charm-t4-gravetide.name: Grave-Tide Pulse
graveyard-charm-t4-gravetide.description: A tide that never fully goes out — it gives back in a steady seep between the larger swells.

graveyard-boots-t4.name: Gravewalker Boots
graveyard-boots-t4.description: Each fallen foe lends a little of its lingering haste — and the more that fall, the harder it becomes to hold you down.

core-controller.name: Controller Core
core-controller.description: The swamp never kills quickly. It simply makes sure nothing leaves the way it came in.

relic-haunted-prism.name: Haunted Prism
relic-haunted-prism.description: The prism weakens the pulse itself so every blessing and affliction can linger with greater force.

trench-abyssal-axe.name: Abyssal Axe
trench-abyssal-axe.description: Patient through the long fight, merciless at the end of it: when the abyss-thing finally weakens, it disappears.

trench-vest-t4.name: Deep Sea Carapace
trench-vest-t4.description: Pressure-forged over an age in the dark; the longer the fight, the more of the deep's weight it turns against your foe.

trench-charm-t4.name: Pressure Vessel
trench-charm-t4.description: Built to hold against a crushing deep — it softens the one enormous blow and breathes life back on a slow count.

trench-boots-t4-stalkers.name: Abyssal Stalkers
trench-boots-t4-stalkers.description: They take you past the great blind hunters unseen — and lend the first strike, when it comes, a killing edge.

trench-boots-t4-treaders.name: Abyssal Treaders
trench-boots-t4-treaders.description: Ballasted for the deep — slows and snares and stuns wash over them and recede twice as fast.

relic-virulent-hourglass.name: Virulent Hourglass
relic-virulent-hourglass.description: The sand falls quickly; what it leaves behind grows harder to escape.

ability-recipe-sweep.name: Sweep
ability-recipe-sweep.description: Learn the Sweep technique: arm your next attack to cleave.

ability-recipe-second-wind.name: Second Wind
ability-recipe-second-wind.description: Learn the Second Wind guard: sharply raise your recovery when badly wounded.

ability-recipe-cleanse.name: Cleanse
ability-recipe-cleanse.description: Learn the Cleanse guard: strip the affliction that is eating you.

ability-recipe-brace.name: Brace
ability-recipe-brace.description: Learn the Brace guard: shed the worst of one heavy blow.

ability-recipe-power-strike.name: Power Strike
ability-recipe-power-strike.description: Learn Power Strike: wind up a heavy blow that hard control can interrupt.

ability-recipe-expose-weakness.name: Expose Weakness
ability-recipe-expose-weakness.description: Learn the Expose Weakness technique: make a target take increased damage.

ability-recipe-hamstring.name: Hamstring
ability-recipe-hamstring.description: Learn Hamstring: arm your next attack to cripple the target's stride.

ability-recipe-bramble-guard.name: Bramble Guard
ability-recipe-bramble-guard.description: Learn the Bramble Guard: armor yourself with thorns that injure attackers.

ability-recipe-charge.name: Charge
ability-recipe-charge.description: Learn Charge: close the gap instantly and land an empowered blow.

ability-recipe-endure.name: Endure
ability-recipe-endure.description: Learn Endure: modest mitigation held long enough to outlast a bad stretch.

ability-recipe-contagion.name: Contagion
ability-recipe-contagion.description: Learn Contagion: cast a target's afflictions outward onto the enemies around it.

ability-recipe-slam.name: Slam
ability-recipe-slam.description: Learn Slam: wind up and drive the blow into the ground, striking everything around the impact.

ability-recipe-binding-strike.name: Binding Strike
ability-recipe-binding-strike.description: Learn Binding Strike: arm your next attack to pin the target where it stands.

ability-recipe-break-free.name: Break Free
ability-recipe-break-free.description: Learn Break Free: tear out of hard control, even while it holds you.

ability-recipe-frenzy.name: Frenzy
ability-recipe-frenzy.description: Learn Frenzy: a short, furious window of raw attack speed.

ability-recipe-quick-strike.name: Quick Strike
ability-recipe-quick-strike.description: Learn Quick Strike: a small, fast opening that is almost always ready.

ability-recipe-detonate.name: Detonate
ability-recipe-detonate.description: Learn Detonate: tear every affliction off a target at once for all the damage they had left.

ability-recipe-disengage.name: Disengage
ability-recipe-disengage.description: Learn Disengage: break contact and buy back the room to keep fighting.

ability-recipe-recuperate.name: Recuperate
ability-recipe-recuperate.description: Learn Recuperate: a long, steady mend that outlasts a fight's worst stretch.

ability-recipe-snipe.name: Snipe
ability-recipe-snipe.description: Learn Snipe: a deliberate shot lined up far outside your usual reach.

ability-recipe-stunning-strike.name: Stunning Strike
ability-recipe-stunning-strike.description: Learn Stunning Strike: a committed blow that puts the target on the floor.

ability-recipe-imbue-lightning.name: Imbue Lightning
ability-recipe-imbue-lightning.description: Learn Imbue Lightning: charge your hands so your next few strikes land with the storm.

rune-recipe-out-of-combat.name: Out of Combat
rune-recipe-out-of-combat.description: Unlocks the situation for rules that run after combat ends.

rune-recipe-reload-safely.name: Reload Safely
rune-recipe-reload-safely.description: Unlocks out-of-combat reload maintenance for reload classes.

rune-recipe-ready-execution.name: Ready Execution
rune-recipe-ready-execution.description: Unlocks out-of-combat execution waiting for cooldown classes.

rune-recipe-focus-highest-hp.name: Focus Highest HP
rune-recipe-focus-highest-hp.description: Unlocks target selection that focuses the enemy with the largest maximum health pool.

rune-recipe-low-hp.name: HP Below 25%
rune-recipe-low-hp.description: Unlocks the situation for emergency behavior.

rune-recipe-avoid-hazards.name: Avoid Hazards
rune-recipe-avoid-hazards.description: Unlocks pathing that routes around damaging and slowing terrain.

rune-recipe-flee.name: Flee
rune-recipe-flee.description: Unlocks retreat behavior for dangerous fights.

rune-recipe-careful-pulling.name: Careful Pulling
rune-recipe-careful-pulling.description: Unlocks approach pathing that avoids drifting toward nearby elite enemies.

rune-recipe-recover-first.name: Recover First
rune-recipe-recover-first.description: Unlocks waiting for full health after combat.

rune-recipe-step-back.name: Step Back
rune-recipe-step-back.description: Unlocks movement that exits visible attack telegraphs before they resolve.

rune-recipe-surrounded.name: Surrounded
rune-recipe-surrounded.description: Unlocks rules for being chased by three or more enemies.

rune-recipe-focus-lowest-hp.name: Focus Lowest HP
rune-recipe-focus-lowest-hp.description: Unlocks target selection for finishing weakened enemies.

rune-recipe-let-dots-finish.name: Let DoTs Finish
rune-recipe-let-dots-finish.description: Unlocks DoT-class target selection that leaves enemies your DoTs should finish.

rune-recipe-spread-dots.name: Spread DoTs
rune-recipe-spread-dots.description: Unlocks DoT-class target selection that rotates between enemies to upkeep DoTs.

rune-recipe-focus-elites.name: Focus Elites
rune-recipe-focus-elites.description: Unlocks target selection that prioritizes elite enemies (the yellow-outlined standouts) before the rest.

stance-recipe-offensive.name: Offensive Stance
stance-recipe-offensive.description: Trade defense for damage and tempo.

stance-recipe-fleeting.name: Fleeting Stance
stance-recipe-fleeting.description: Abandon pressure to reposition and escape.

stance-recipe-tanking.name: Tanking Stance
stance-recipe-tanking.description: Become dramatically safer and dramatically slower.

stance-recipe-berserker.name: Berserker Stance
stance-recipe-berserker.description: Gain tempo while bleeding your own life away.

stance-recipe-warding.name: Warding Stance
stance-recipe-warding.description: Endure harmful statuses at a severe offensive cost.

stance-recipe-predator.name: Predator Stance
stance-recipe-predator.description: Stalk enemies and empower the opening strike.

stance-recipe-execute.name: Execute Stance
stance-recipe-execute.description: Finish wounded prey at the cost of neutral pressure.

stance-recipe-time-to-strike.name: Time to Strike
stance-recipe-time-to-strike.description: Commit to one empowered hit at the cost of ordinary tempo.

stance-recipe-brawler.name: Brawler Stance
stance-recipe-brawler.description: Endure the pressure of many attackers.

stance-recipe-reaper.name: Reaper Stance
stance-recipe-reaper.description: Turn a kill into short-lived momentum against the next target.

stance-recipe-recuperating.name: Recuperating Stance
stance-recipe-recuperating.description: Surrender offense to regenerate during combat.

stance-recipe-powering-up.name: Powering Up
stance-recipe-powering-up.description: Charge through a weak posture, then leave to release stored offense.

rite-recipe-swift-repose.name: Swift Repose
rite-recipe-swift-repose.description: Leave combat sooner and begin recovery earlier.

rite-recipe-purification.name: Purification
rite-recipe-purification.description: Remove harmful carryover when combat ends.

rite-recipe-lingering-battle.name: Lingering Battle
rite-recipe-lingering-battle.description: Remain in combat state longer between engagements.

rite-recipe-mechanic-renewal.name: Mechanic Renewal
rite-recipe-mechanic-renewal.description: Prepare your class mechanic when combat ends.

rite-recipe-ability-reprieve.name: Ability Reprieve
rite-recipe-ability-reprieve.description: Reduce equipped ability cooldowns when combat ends.
